title: Fix SSR failure: make useDataScope context-optional
body:
Next.js build failing on `/docs/components/complex/table` during static generation because `useDataScope` unconditionally throws when `SchemaRendererProvider` is absent.

## Changes

- **`useDataScope` hook**: Return `undefined` instead of throwing when context is missing. Added guard to prevent reduce operation on undefined dataSource.

- **`SimpleTableRenderer`**: Support inline data fallback (`schema.data`, `schema.props.data`) when no binding exists. Accept both `accessorKey`/`key` and `header`/`label` column properties for API flexibility.

```tsx
// Before: throws during SSR
const data = useDataScope(schema.bind);

// After: gracefully handles missing context
const boundData = useDataScope(schema.bind);
const data = boundData || schema.data || schema.props?.data || [];
```

This preserves data binding functionality while enabling components to render during static generation with inline data.
